title: Purple Hydrangea
body:
"Purple hydrengeas are enchanting flowers with deep purple hues, evoking feelings of mystery and royalty."

Description

Purple Hydrangea is a item that can be found on bushes. It may be sold to Jer Junkman for $50 per Purple Hydrangea.

When put into a Composter, the fill level increases by 1.2% per flower.
